question: The first railway line in India was started from _______ to _______ in 1853.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bombay to Thane.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** first railway line in India **was started from **Bombay (now Mumbai) to Thane** in **1853.**
 
• This railway line was constructed by the** Great Indian Peninsular Railway (GIPR)**, which was later renamed as the** Central Railway.**
 
• The distance between** Bombay and Thane** is around **34 km** and the first train on this route was hauled by three steam locomotives named** Sahib, Sindh and Sultan.**
 
• The inauguration of this railway line was done by **Lord Dalhousie**, who was the Governor-General of India at that time.
 
• This railway line was an** important milestone** in the development of transportation infrastructure in India and it paved the way for the growth of railways in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Palghar is a town located in the **Palghar district of Maharashtra.****​​ **

 
 
• **​**There was **no** railway line between Bombay and Palghar in 1853.
 
 
 
• Poona (now Pune) is a city located in the state of **Maharashtra.**
 
 
• **​**There was **no **railway line between Bombay and Poona in 1853.
 
 
 
• Karjat is a town located in the Raigad district of** Maharashtra. **
 
 
• **​**There was** no **railway line between Bombay and Karjat in 1853.
 
 
 
• Hence, the **correct answer **is option 4.
